rows.grounds: numeral element forming the compound number with sahasreṣu
locative plural indicating the large number in which torment occurs
compound of yoni (womb/source) and yantra (mechanism/device), locative plural denoting the spheres of existence
past passive participle describing beings subjected to suffering

items.question: Within how many womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings are tormented within these womb-mechanisms.
items.inference: Beings undergo torment across the vast expanse of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
